global_rules: Follow 'The Anti-AI Designer' E1 persona. No generic UI. Total focus on high-fidelity, high-trust fintech aesthetic.
Do not use generic sans-serif fonts for headings. Use IBM Plex Sans exclusively.
Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for numerical data, wallet addresses, balances, and tx hashes.
Borders must be 1px solid, sharp or slightly rounded (max rounded-md). No soft bloated shadows.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover/focus states, particularly focus:ring-1 focus:ring-binance-gold.
Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000). Use the pre-configured --binance-black and --binance-text variables.
CTAs using --binance-gold MUST have --binance-black text to guarantee accessibility/contrast.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid: High density, logical grouping, structured 1px borders between segments.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align data fields for easy scanning. Center main CTA if it takes full width.

header.style: Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[var(--binance-black)]/80 border-b border-[var(--binance-gray-light)].
header.content: Left: Shield Icon + 'CryptoTransfer Pro'. Right: Network Dropdown + Connect Wallet Button (Outlined default, Solid gold when connected).

transfer_card.internal_layout: Stack layout (flex-col) with gap-6. Use divider lines (border-t border-[var(--binance-gray-light)]) between major steps.

inputs.style: bg-[var(--binance-gray)] border border-[var(--binance-gray-light)] rounded-md px-4 py-3 text-[var(--binance-text)] focus:border-[var(--binance-gold)] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[var(--binance-gold)] transition-all font-mono
inputs.label_style: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--binance-text-secondary)] mb-2 block

buttons.primary: w-full bg-[var(--binance-gold)] hover:bg-[var(--binance-gold-light)] text-[var(--binance-black)] font-semibold py-4 rounded-md transition-all active:scale-[0.99] flex justify-center items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[var(--binance-gray)] hover:bg-[var(--binance-gray-light)] text-[var(--binance-text)] border border-[var(--binance-gray-light)] py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-all
buttons.max_button: text-xs bg-[var(--binance-gray-light)] text-[var(--binance-text)] hover:text-[var(--binance-gold)] px-2 py-1 rounded transition-colors

progress_stepper.style: flex items-center justify-between mb-8 text-sm font-medium

status_modal.style: Use the provided .glass class for modal overlay. Centralize success/pending icon.
status_modal.animations: Use .animate-pulse-gold for pending, .animate-slide-up for modal entry.

interactions_and_motion.scan_effect: Apply the custom `.scan-effect` class to the destination address box during validation.
interactions_and_motion.status_dots: Use `.status-dot.status-pending` for awaiting confirmation, `.status-dot.status-success` for confirmed.

background_image.instructions: Set as body background with opacity-20 (or background-blend-mode: overlay) to provide a premium, deep tech crypto texture without distracting from the UI.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide icons strictly. ShieldCheck (Security/Logo), Wallet (Connect), ArrowRight (Transfer), Fingerprint (Auth vibe), CheckCircle2 (Success), ExternalLink (Explorer).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast passes, especially for --binance-gold text on --binance-black.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: MUST add `data-testid` to all inputs, buttons, balance displays, and status text.
accessibility_and_testing.focus: Keyboard focus rings MUST be visible (--binance-gold).

instructions_to_main_agent: Load the provided `index.css` to leverage --binance custom properties and keyframe animations.
Build the dashboard focusing on the Transfer Wizard as the hero element.
Implement WalletConnect and MetaMask options using ethers.js or wagmi. Mock the actual transfer logic using a timeout if no real blockchain endpoint is provided.
Break the flow into: 1. Connect -> 2. Enter Address & Amount -> 3. Confirm (show mock security scan) -> 4. Transaction Sent (with mock tx hash linking to etherscan).
Strictly follow the typography layout: headings in IBM Plex Sans, all monetary values and addresses in JetBrains Mono.
Apply `data-testid` attributes on all critical paths (e.g., `data-testid="wallet-connect-btn"`, `data-testid="transfer-amount-input"`).
Use standard Shadcn UI primitive logic where applicable (Dialog for tx status, Select for networks), but heavily style them to match the Binance Dark theme specified in this file.
